Existing author pairings remain preferre: keeps $reviewer preferred for $author while OpenCode is available
A retryable preferred-reviewer failure s: completes the eligible Codex retry before considering OpenCode
A terminal preferred-reviewer failure sk: skips an alternate-model route when the reviewer does not advertise model selection
OpenCode independently reviews Claude-au: prefers independent OpenCode fallback over same-author feedback
OpenCode independent evidence satisfies: uses OpenCode as an independent fallback before same-agent degraded review
OpenCode independently reviews Codex-aut: uses OpenCode independently for Codex authors after Claude routes fail
OpenCode starts when the shared deadline: starts OpenCode when exactly one minimum route budget remains
OpenCode is not started when the shared: does not launch OpenCode below the minimum route budget under %s
OpenCode failure preserves the existing: retains degraded feedback after OpenCode failure under %s
Claude is the preferred reviewer for Ope: prefers Claude for OpenCode authors with every reviewer available
Codex reviews OpenCode-authored work whe: uses Codex independently for OpenCode authors after Claude routes fail
OpenCode self-review cannot satisfy inde: never treats OpenCode self-review as independent under %s
A complete OpenCode event stream yields: accepts one closed OpenCode result as required independent evidence
An oversized OpenCode event stream is re: rejects an oversized OpenCode event stream without evidence
A mismatched OpenCode dispatch blocks th: blocks required review when OpenCode returns a different dispatch identity
A denied OpenCode tool request cannot pr: denies a requested OpenCode tool before accepting its complete result
Reviewed-source mutation makes OpenCode: marks OpenCode review stale when the reviewed source changes
Disposable-packet mutation fails OpenCod: rejects OpenCode packet mutation without changing the reviewed source
A timed-out OpenCode route records no ev: records a timed-out OpenCode route without evidence
A failed OpenCode process records no evi: records a failed OpenCode process without evidence
Unsupported authors do not gain an OpenC: rejects unsupported author %s without launching OpenCode
